title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud development instructions
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with development environment instructions for Cursor Cloud agents. ### What's included - Overview of the application (Next.js 16 monolith for AO qualification) - Key dev commands table (dev server, typecheck, unit tests, e2e, build) - Known caveats: - `npm run lint` is broken (Next.js 16 removed `next lint`, no standalone ESLint config) - Login requires browser/Playwright (server actions, not simple POST) - No database — all data from Google Sheets - Env file setup instructions ### Demo Login flow and dashboard working with local dev credentials: ![Login page](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-1e49e871-2d11-4118-b6c4-1f3347f885ed) ![Dashboard page](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-8d1be1a0-ad6a-4d20-86ef-d40357a2d5e1) ### Testing performed - ✅ `npm run typecheck` — passes cleanly - ✅ `npm run test:unit` — 53 tests pass across 16 files - ✅ `npm run build` — production build succeeds - ✅ `npm run dev` — dev server starts on port 3000 - ✅ Browser login + dashboard navigation verified
